info.name: Pioneer DDJ-WeGO
info.author: Samuel Nicholas, Dmytro Hakman
info.description: 4-deck mapping for the Pioneer DDJ-WeGO with Jog FX and jog lighting.

option.label: Blink SYNC on beat
option.description: SYNC LED blinks on every beat instead of showing sync state.

option.label: Initial auto loop size (beats)
option.description: Beat length the AUTO LOOP button uses at startup. Turn the AUTO LOOP encoder to change it while running.

option.label: Route deck N to effect unit N
option.description: On startup, assign each deck to the effect unit its Jog FX buttons control. Turn off to keep your own effect routing.

option.label: Soft-takeover for mixer controls
option.description: Ignore volume, EQ, crossfader, headphone mix and tempo until the knob/fader passes the on-screen value, so switching decks does not jump them. Off = immediate pickup.
